mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, we are seeing overcast skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 66 degrees under a Waning Gibbous moon.

City officials have announced that Hwy M will be closed near the Aldi site from October 6 through October 9 for road improvements, including milling and asphalt work. Also, early voting for the November 3 election is available at City Hall starting October 20.
There is plenty to do in Verona, with the Downtown Farmer's Market happening today, trivia night at the Bogey Factory today, and a happy hour at ART House 360 tomorrow.
In our weekly police report, on September 19, a 10-year-old child who went missing from Lincoln Street was safely located and reunited with their parents.
Stop by for today's delicious flavor of the day, which is Double Strawberry. The store opens today at 10:00 AM.
